mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outlines WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outlines (user_id, title, topic, subject, level, total_duration, module_count, modules_data, ai_generated, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{topic}, #{subject}, #{level}, #{totalDuration}, #{moduleCount}, #{modulesData}, TRUE, 'active', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE outlines SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outlines WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
